raa.permutations: two independent uniform permutations; explicit arrays; not fixed-size public seed expansion

raa.code_roles: Gx independent from primary Gy; secondary Gprime independent from both
raa.sampling: unbiased bounded rejection from fresh random words; Fisher-Yates permutations

protocol3_capsule.private_material: fresh ex or retained correction, one-use client query owner
protocol3_capsule.publication: full P=M Gx and Q=Gy^T M validation against bound matrix and explicit codes

protocol2_capsule.secondary_parameter_provenance: concrete source-compatible Protocol 2 instantiation for capsule; not recovered evaluated implementation parameters
